body.h: You need two green clubs, two blue clubs and a red and an orange club. The orange club is a special club. Whoever has the orange club is the leader. If the leader passes a blue club then you pass on four count. If they pass a green club you pass on three count. If they pass a red or orange club you pass on two count. Sometimes the pattern gets stuck, for instance if both the green clubs are being passed every time. You can change this by throwing a double pass.
